life expectancy code

Loading packages in

Loaded the “life expectancy.csv” dataset and downloaded ggplot2 functions.

Modelling Health Expenditure % vs. Life Expectancy

ggplot(dataset, aes(x = `Health Expenditure %`, y = `Life Expectancy World Bank`)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.05, width = 0.01, height = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Life Expectancy vs Health Expenditure %",
    x = "Health Expenditure %",
    y = "Life Expectancy"
  ) +
# regression line
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## Warning: Removed 330 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_smooth()`).
## Warning: Removed 330 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

model <- lm(`Life Expectancy World Bank` ~ `Health Expenditure %`, data = dataset)
summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = `Life Expectancy World Bank` ~ `Health Expenditure %`, 
##     data = dataset)
## 
## Residuals:
##     Min      1Q  Median      3Q     Max 
## -35.082  -4.474   2.678   6.434  16.305 
## 
## Coefficients:
##                        Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
## (Intercept)            62.45581    0.42255  147.81   <2e-16 ***
## `Health Expenditure %`  1.18436    0.06289   18.83   <2e-16 ***
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
## 
## Residual standard error: 8.766 on 2974 degrees of freedom
##   (330 observations deleted due to missingness)
## Multiple R-squared:  0.1065, Adjusted R-squared:  0.1062 
## F-statistic: 354.6 on 1 and 2974 DF,  p-value: < 2.2e-16

Modelling Country Income Group vs. Life Expectancy

dataset$IncomeNum <- as.numeric(factor(
  dataset$IncomeGroup,
  levels = c(
    "Low income",
    "Lower middle income",
    "Upper middle income",
    "High income"
  )
))
ggplot(dataset, aes(x = IncomeNum, y = `Life Expectancy World Bank`)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.05, width = 0.05, height = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue", linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c(
      "Low income",
      "Lower middle income",
      "Upper middle income",
      "High income"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Life Expectancy by Income Group (Linear Trend)",
    x = "Income Group",
    y = "Life Expectancy (World Bank)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## Warning: Removed 188 rows containing non-finite outside the scale range
## (`stat_smooth()`).
## Warning: Removed 188 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
## (`geom_point()`).

model <- lm(`Life Expectancy World Bank` ~ `IncomeNum`, data = dataset)
summary(model)
## 
## Call:
## lm(formula = `Life Expectancy World Bank` ~ IncomeNum, data = dataset)
